name: Kassadin
title: The Void Walker

passive.name: Void Stone

description.normalized: Gains a shield that aborbs 50 (+30% AP) magic damage for 1.5 seconds when casting an ability near a visible enemy champion.

passive.rawParsedText: Gains a shield that aborbs 50 (+30% AP) magic damage for 1.5 seconds when casting an ability near a visible enemy champion.

q.name: Null Sphere

description.normalized: Fires an orb that deals 80 / 145 / 210 / 275 (+80% AP) magic damage and silences the first enemy hit for 1 second.

q.rawParsedText: Fires an orb that deals 80 / 145 / 210 / 275 (+80% AP) magic damage and silences the first enemy hit for 1 second.

w.name: Nether Blade

description.normalized: Enhances his next attack within 4 seconds to gain 250 range, deal an additional 50 / 80 / 110 / 140 (+50% AP) magic damage and restore 5% (15% vs. champions) of missing mana. If the attack killed the target Nether Blade's remaining cooldown is reduced by 50%.

w.rawParsedText:
Enhances his next attack within 4 seconds to gain 250 range, deal an additional 50 / 80 / 110 / 140 (+50% AP) magic damage and restore 5% (15% vs. champions) of missing mana.

If the attack killed the target Nether Blade's remaining cooldown is reduced by 50%.

e.name: Force Pulse

description.normalized: Deals 60 / 100 / 140 / 180 (+50% AP) magic damage to enemies and slows them by 30% for 1 second. Force Pulse is enhanced after 6 other abilities are cast nearby, dealing 40% increased damage and slowing for 90% instead.

r.name: Riftwalk

description.normalized: Blinks to target location and deals 80 / 100 / 120 (+30% AP +1.5% Mana) magic damage to nearby enemies.The next Riftwalk cast within 12 seconds deals 50% increased damage and costs 200% additional mana (Stacks 3 times).
